why: phase-417 W4.e -- the polling half, added so the RFC-0022 polling tier reads the same in all three languages. The reason, the bound and what forced it are at `c:guard_condition_is_triggered`; in one line: the executor consumes the flag on dispatch, so this answers "set and not yet dispatched", and rcl/rclcpp/rclrs have no reader because a wait set is their only way to observe a guard condition. This is the clearing half: it takes the flag without dispatching, and Rust's returns what the flag WAS so a poller can take-and-clear without racing another thread's `trigger`.
